system.description: The oneiromancer sends messages, warnings or threats to a sleeping target through his dreams; the target remembers them clearly upon waking. This power may target anyone the thaumaturge has previously met, inserting a static dream-sequence up to five minutes long that recurs until the target wakes. This power requires the presence of a Storyteller or Narrator to provide results, and requires at least five minutes of dreamlike trance beforehand.
